questions: Did these twisting postures begin suddenly, over minutes or hours?
Have you recently started, stopped, or increased an antipsychotic, antidepressant, anti-nausea medicine, or other dopamine-blocking drug?
Did the postures begin soon after taking one of those medicines?
Are you having difficulty breathing or swallowing now?
Do the postures occur continuously rather than in brief attacks?
Do they disappear completely when you are asleep?
Can you temporarily suppress or voluntarily relax the postures?
Do the postures improve when you touch a particular part of your body or use another “sensory trick”?
Do the postures change substantially when your attention is distracted?
Have you ever had similar abnormal postures or spasms before?
Have the symptoms progressively spread or worsened over months or years?
Did the symptoms begin before you were 20 years old?
Has anyone in your family had similar abnormal movements or postures?
Have you had tremor, slowness, stiffness, balance problems, or difficulty walking?
Have you had episodes of loss of awareness, tongue biting, or loss of bladder control?
Have you noticed personality change, depression, irritability, or declining memory?
Have you had jaundice, abdominal swelling, or other liver problems?
Have you had a recent head injury, brain infection, stroke, or exposure to toxins?
